title: OpenAI - Workspace admins may be unable to manage plugins
text:
Service: OpenAI
Incident: Workspace admins may be unable to manage plugins
Status: resolved
Impact: major
Started: None
Resolved: 2026-10-09T23:26:59Z
Updates:
- 2026-10-09T23:26:59Z: resolved - All impacted services have now fully recovered.
- 2026-10-09T22:52:35Z: monitoring - We are seeing recovery in workspace administrators’ ability to view and manage plugin availability and settings. We are monitoring to ensure service remains stable.
- 2026-10-09T21:48:34Z: investigating - We are investigating an issue affecting some ChatGPT workspace administrators’ ability to view and manage plugin availability and settings. Some users may also see plugins as unavailable. We will provide another update as soon as we have more information.
